milestones.title: MVP
milestones.description: First usable release for early customers

epics.title: Project foundations
epics.goal: A running, tested, continuously integrated skeleton that every story builds on
epics.measure: CI green on main; a new developer runs the app in under 10 minutes

epics.title: Account management
epics.goal: Customers can create and recover their account on their own
epics.measure: Support tickets about account access < 5 per month

stories.title: Set up the walking skeleton (layout, tests, lint, CI)
stories.description: Create the project layout, dependency management, a health-check endpoint, the test runner, the linter/static analysis and a CI workflow running them on every pull request.
acceptance_criteria: The health-check endpoint returns HTTP 200 with the application version
`make test` and `make lint` run locally and in CI; CI is required on pull requests
CLAUDE.md lists the exact install/run/test/lint commands

stories.title: Sign up with email and password
stories.want: to create an account with my email and a password
stories.benefit: I can save my data and come back later
stories.context: Passwords follow the OWASP ASVS L1 rules. Email confirmation is required before first login.

acceptance_criteria.given: a valid email and a password of 12+ characters
acceptance_criteria.then: my account is created and a confirmation email is sent
I see a neutral message and no second account is created
the form explains the rule and nothing is saved

stories.measure: 80 % of started sign-ups are completed; 0 accounts with unconfirmed email can log in
stories.technical_notes: Hash with the framework's default password hasher (argon2id). Rate-limit the endpoint.

stories.title: Reset a forgotten password by email
stories.want: to receive a reset link by email
stories.benefit: I regain access without contacting support

acceptance_criteria.then: I receive a single-use link valid for 30 minutes
I am invited to request a new one

stories.measure: 95 % of resets completed in under 2 minutes
